entries.desc: Contract helpers sign and verify runner envelopes and job specs with deterministic canonical JSON bytes.

evidence.note: Root npm script delegates to the focused authority runner contracts smoke; it verifies deterministic canonical JSON bytes, Ed25519 sign/verify roundtrip, every runner envelope shape, and JobSpec/receipt signing paths.

entries.desc: Invalid signatures, missing actor IDs, or same producer/verifier run bindings fail classification and verification.

evidence.note: Smoke covers invalid signatures, wrong keys, tampered payloads, malformed signatures, missing actorId/nonce/createdAt, and same-run producer/verifier collapse including whitespace-only variants.

entries.desc: Adding signing primitives does not promote ordinary local/shadow workflow submissions to receipt-backed L2+.

evidence.note: Smoke proves signing primitives alone do not promote ordinary local/shadow runner envelopes to receipt-backed L2+: missingRunnerL2Requirements still requires run bindings, provider/model/vendor, command/transcript/diff hashes, and verified authority receipt.

entries.desc: Client methods hit the expected authority endpoints and parse success responses.

evidence.note: Root npm script delegates to the focused authority runner client smoke; fake authority server captures all 7 expected runner endpoints exactly once with signed request bodies and typed schema parsing.

entries.desc: HTTP errors, malformed bodies, and missing authority URL remain controlled failures; off mode performs zero network calls.

evidence.note: Smoke covers HTTP errors, malformed 2xx bodies, connection refused, timeout, empty path params, off mode zero-network refusal, missing/whitespace KOALA_AUTHORITY_URL refusal, and runtime re-validation of env/override mode.

entries.desc: Policy discovery still never POSTs evidence or runner mutations.

evidence.note: Smoke proves policy discovery remains read-only: exactly one GET /v1/authority/policy and no POST to /v1/evidence, runner register, jobs claim, actor keys, or provider events; overclaim policy bodies containing accepted/receipt fields still fail.
